description: RULED S478 item 2, the reverse order: in `@who = "z"; reset(@who);` the reset comes later, so the run it starts is the newest start and its load ("a") replaces the written "z" when it settles (§13.9.4 rules 1 and 3). RUNTIME, sqlEngine "real".
rationale: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — S477 owner questions 1 and 2" item 2: "The run a reset triggers starts at the reset (§13.9.4 rule 1, most-recently-started wins)". §13.9.4 rule 1: "The one that started most recently wins." §13.9.2: "A reset of a pending cell (§6.8) is the request's re-run."
